# PII detection fixtures - POSITIVE cases
#
# Format:  <expected_kind> <TAB> <question text>
#
# Every identifier here is SYNTHETIC. Aadhaar values are produced by
# verhoeff_check_digit() from an arbitrary 11-digit payload, so they are valid by
# construction and are not any real person's number. PANs use the published
# 4th-character entity-type codes with obviously fictional letters. Do not
# replace these with real values copied from anywhere - that would put genuine
# personal data in the repository, which is the exact failure this module exists
# to prevent.
#
# Load-bearing rule: a new detector added to pii.py MUST have a case here. A
# detector with no fixture is a detector nobody has ever seen fire.
pan	My PAN is ABCPA1234B
pan	pan aaapa1234b
pan	Please check PAN number ABCPA1234B for my filing
pan	permanent account number: ABCPA1234B
aadhaar	My aadhaar is 379980670381
aadhaar	aadhaar 3799 8067 0381 linked to my bank
aadhaar	Aadhaar number 379980670381 needs updating
account	a/c no. 30123456789 please check
account	account number 98765432101
account	acc no 123456789012
account	account: 4001234567890123
otp	my otp is 492015
otp	verification code 1234
otp	security code 45678
otp	pin 4321
otp	one time password 987654
email	mail me at ravi.kumar@example.co.in
email	contact r.kumar+funds@example.co.in please
phone	call me on +91 98765 43210
phone	my number is 9876543210
phone	+91-98765-43210
phone	reach me at 098765 43210
